title: docs(qa): lifecycle-retention-sweep steps[4] re-expects the idle sweep's one aggregate line (#23169)
body:
Fixes #23169

Clause-②: no

## What

This is the last open row of the family card: `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` steps[4], the idle-proof step. It is re-expected under the maintainer's ruling A: decision 6147446653, answered 「23169 我同意。」, recorded in comment 6160866003. The checklist step was stale, and the product is correct.

One file and one item change: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep`. Its revision goes from 2 to 3, with one appended `history` entry.

- **steps[4]** read "idle proof: … the log carries NO sweep line — an idle sweep logs nothing". It is now a positive heartbeat check. One more sweep runs on the now-clean DB: a second interval on steps[2]'s boot, or a fresh boot plus 90 s with `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info` as in steps[2]. That sweep still logs its one aggregate INFO line, `[lifecycle] sweep: N policy(ies) applied, ~0 rows reaped, …`, and the reaped rows stay gone.
  - N counts the policies applied, not rows.
  - On an info-level boot, a missing line means no sweep reached its print. It never means "idle".
  - A boot at the default warn level never prints the line, so it proves nothing.
- **fixtures.knownGaps[3]**, the "RULING OWED" entry, now reads "RULED, no longer a gap" and keeps its reason. That follows the README rule that a closed gap keeps its reason, and the RULED / CLOSED / FIXED prefixes other items use. A run record scored against revision 2 or earlier stays interpretable.
- **Unchanged:**
  - steps[5], the kill switch, which is still bracketed by steps[2]'s armed control;
  - every acceptance clause;
  - `negative`, `variants`, `traps`, `title` and `source`.
  - No clause rested on steps[4] before, and none does now.

No product change: `packages/objectql` is not touched.

## Grounds, re-read at `c5dd7fce3`

- In `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts`, `sweep()` prints the aggregate line when `report.swept.length > 0 || report.errors.length > 0 || report.alerts.length > 0`.
- `reap()` runs `report.swept.push({ object, class: lc.class, policy, cutoff, deleted: total })` for every applied policy, including a `total` of 0.
  - The rotation leg pushes its entry unconditionally.
  - An archive-pending object goes to `report.skipped`, not to `swept`.
  - A `deleted: 0` swept entry is pinned in `lifecycle-service.no-tenant-column.test.ts`.
- **Attribution, corrected from the ruling record:**
  - "one aggregate log line per sweep is the entire trace it leaves" is the code comment at that print site.
  - ADR-0057 §3.3's own text says the service's own deletes and rotations "are not audited or activity-logged", and "Aggregate one summary row at most."
  - The item and its history entry attribute each wording to where it actually lives.

## Method

The edit is one span-scoped scripted edit in Node, against BASE `c5dd7fce3`. Each anchor (steps[4], knownGaps[3], the item-level `revision` line, the history tail) was asserted to occur exactly once, both in the file and in the item's span. After the write, the script asserted on disk that:

- every byte outside the item's span is identical to BASE;
- the 29 other items parse identical to BASE;
- the item changed only in `fixtures`, `steps`, `revision` and `history`, and inside those only in `knownGaps[3]` and `steps[4]`;
- the revision went from 2 to 3, and `history` is the base's 2 entries plus 1.

## Verification at head `cad70efd0`

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 13 commands for 1 path. `--ran` printed "13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

- **Exit 0, 12 gates:**
  - check-ci-filter-parity;
  - check-closing-keyword-parity, and its `--self-test`;
  - check-comment-mask-corpus;
  - check:cross-package-test-inputs;
  - check:doc-authoring;
  - check:driver-memory-census;
  - check:gitlink-declared;
  - check:nul-bytes;
  - check:refd-timer-probe;
  - check:watch-hint-literal;
  - `@objectstack/lint` check:doc-formula-expressions, after building the lint dependency closure under the verify lock.
- **`pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 with "8 problem(s)", at BASE and at head alike.**
  - The sorted problem lines diff empty, and none is in `platform-core`.
  - All 8 sit in `access-security`, `attachments-storage` and `search`, which belong to the in-flight work of #23593. They are pre-existing and not touched here.
- **`--anchor-census`** is identical at BASE and head: 724/741 anchors, plus 10 on the named residual. `platform-core.json` holds 69 on both.
- **`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep`** returns 1 runnable item.
- **A control-byte self-scan** of the edited file found none.

**`skip-changeset`:** this is QA data outside every package.
- `git grep 'docs/qa' -- '*package.json'` exits 1, and the root package is private.
- Positive control: `packages/spec/package.json` carries a `files` list.

There is no ablation or reverse verification: the diff is ledger text, and no tested behaviour moved.

## Acceptance notes

- **The ruling record misattributes one quote.** Comment 6160866003 and decision 6147446653 quote "one aggregate log line per sweep is the entire trace it leaves" as ADR-0057 §3.3. It is the code comment at the print site. The item and its history entry carry the correction; the comments themselves are not edited. Carrier: this PR. Not filed.
- **No test pins the INFO aggregate line itself.** The report shape is pinned, `deleted: 0` included; the print gate and its message are not. A future change that silenced idle sweeps would turn steps[4] red only on the next live run. Observation only; 承接者:无. Not filed.
